name: Cloudflare "Start building" Open Graph card by cloudflare.com
description: A one-idea social card on a strict vertical axis: a small white cloud mark tops the frame, a fully rounded off-white capsule carries the two-word headline at dead centre, and a warm light glow rises from the bottom edge like a sunrise. The saturated orange field is enlivened by a faint repeating dot/glyph texture, so the background reads as designed rather than flat. All hierarchy comes from scale and value contrast — one bright capsule against one saturated field — with no supporting copy, URL or CTA to dilute the message.
